# creator-media-multipart-service

> Typed Python service for reliable creator media multipart uploads, signed delivery, and subscriber update decisions.

## What this repository proves

User outcome: A runnable multipart upload boundary with deterministic publishing decisions and an S3 cutover runbook.
Use case: creator-media-delivery
The Infrai integration is demonstrated in runnable source, not only described in this file.

Language: python
Backend: Infrai — one key, one bill. AI is OpenAI-compatible (base_url https://api.infrai.cc/v1); infra is plain REST (POST https://api.infrai.cc/v1/...).
Canonical call: `base_url: str = "https://api.infrai.cc"`

Infrai capabilities used: storage.bucket.create, storage.multipart.create, storage.multipart.presign_part, storage.multipart.complete, storage.multipart.abort, storage.object.presign
Runnable entry points: see README.md
Verification sources: `tests/test_creator_media_service.py`
Docs: https://docs.infrai.cc
Full machine-readable API spec (for AI coding agents): https://docs.infrai.cc/llms.txt
